news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro shares extend rebound, trading up over 8% intraday
news.summary: CLPT traded as high as $16.19 and continued a multi-week bounce off its post-Q2-earnings lows (shares fell to roughly $13 after the August 3 miss); the move tracks broader recovery/analyst sentiment rather than a single confirmed company-specific announcement, with consensus rating still split between Hold and Strong Buy and an average price target near $25-$29.

news.headline: MAK Capital discloses 7.8% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund LP and Michael A. Kaufman reported beneficial ownership of 2,375,861 shares (7.8%) as of June 30, 2026, up from a 6.3% stake disclosed in an earlier May 2026 filing, all held with shared (not sole) voting/dispositive power.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Q2 2026 earnings call: management frames revenue miss as service-timing issue, not lost demand
news.source: Company earnings call transcript (Globe and Mail / Yahoo Finance)
news.summary: Management attributed the roughly $1.8M Q2 revenue shortfall to timing of clinical case and preclinical service delivery rather than weaker underlying demand, while flagging opex growth of 51% (largely IRRAS integration and team expansion) and cash declining to $29.4M.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue of $10.9M, cuts full-year guidance to $48M-$52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue grew 18% YoY to $10.9M (about $1.8M below the $12.73M consensus) as a 62% jump in neurosurgery navigation/therapy revenue was offset by a 15% decline in biologics/drug delivery revenue; shares fell over 15% after hours and full-year revenue guidance was cut to $48M-$52M.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro outlines five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in annual revenue
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management presented a long-term roadmap built around cell-and-gene-therapy delivery to the brain, citing 175+ active global centers, 60+ active biopharma partners, and expectations of roughly 10 partner clinical data readouts over the next 18 months.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure plans to submit its Biologics License Application for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease gene therapy delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula) in Q3 2026, following FDA agreement that 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval filing; a filing would be a strong read-through for ClearPoint's platform adoption.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro's next quarterly results (Q3 2026) are expected around November 5, 2026, which will show whether the Q2 revenue shortfall was indeed timing-related as management claimed.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly 10 biopharma partner data readouts and 10-15 enrolling clinical trials using ClearPoint's delivery platform over the next 18 months, any of which could move the stock.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study at ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL)
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's newly acquired Torrey Pines preclinical facility has signed its first statement of work for a GLP IND-enabling study, expected to be performed in the first half of 2027, an early proof point for the CAL revenue pillar.

catalysts.label: First commercial cell/gene therapy approvals using ClearPoint delivery
catalysts.detail: Management believes renewed FDA openness toward rare-disease BLAs could enable the first commercial approvals of cell/gene therapies delivered via ClearPoint's system as early as 2027, which would open a capital-equipment and disposables revenue ramp.

pulse: Since the August 11-12 disclosures (Q2 miss framed as service timing, MAK Capital's 7.8% passive stake), there has been no major new company-specific press release; CLPT has instead been mechanically recovering off its post-earnings low near $13, trading back up around $16-17 (up roughly 8% on August 25) without a single confirmed fresh catalyst behind the move. The dominant forward-looking story remains unchanged: cash is down to $29.4M after a 51% opex jump, full-year guidance was cut to $48-52M, and the bull case now rests on uniQure's planned Q3 2026 AMT-130 BLA filing and a wave of roughly 10 partner data readouts expected over the next 18 months, with the next hard checkpoint being Q3 2026 earnings around November 5.
